edits.reason: Say narrates the flip as a three-step sequence: 'Price breaks a resistance, comes back to retest it, and the old resistance now holds as support.' The level and the retest are already labelled, but the break event itself is unmarked. 'breakout' is a valid sr_flip point anchor, so marking it makes the chart teach the full sequence the voice walks through. Non-redundant with the accumulated show (level / retest / top).

noAnchorGaps.concept: Stop placement just beneath the support level
noAnchorGaps.quote: enter long with your stop just beneath
noAnchorGaps.why: move horizontal_sr exposes only level(L) and touch1/2/3(pt); there is no stop anchor below the level, so a stop line cannot be drawn without inventing an anchor

noAnchorGaps.concept: Trigger candle confirming buyers at the level (the entry trigger)
noAnchorGaps.quote: look for a trigger candle confirming buyers, and enter long
noAnchorGaps.why: move horizontal_sr has no separate trigger-candle anchor; the entry trigger is the buy at touch1, which is already marked 'buy the first test', so no new show is needed

noAnchorGaps.concept: Tight stop / clear invalidation below the flipped level
noAnchorGaps.quote: Buying that first retest gives you a tight stop, a clear invalidation
noAnchorGaps.why: move sr_flip exposes level(L) and test1/breakout/retest/top(pt); there is no stop/invalidation anchor below the flipped level, so it cannot be drawn without inventing an anchor

notes: Verified both moves against ground-truth anchors. horizontal_sr={level(L),touch1/2/3(pt)}; sr_flip={level(L),test1/breakout/retest/top(pt)}. Accepted the auditor's one real add (breakout marker on the flip beat) — anchor valid, kind/type correct (marker on a point anchor), say-justified, non-redundant. Both proposed stop/invalidation gaps and the trigger-candle gap are correctly noAnchorGaps (no stop or trigger-candle anchors exist on either move). No additional gaps found: the bounce beat already labels support + first/weakest tests; the flip beat already labels the flipped level, the retest entry, and the continuation top. No stale/mislabeled existing show items to fix.
